cohort: Children diagnosed with intussusception admitted to two hospitals in China from May 2023 to December 2024.
finding: A nomogram was developed that reliably predicts the likelihood of spontaneous reduction of intussusception (SROI) in pediatric patients, identifying older age and short-segment intussusception as significantly associated with enhanced SROI possibility.
mod_finding: Mode of birth (MOB) was identified as one of the six key predictors for the spontaneous reduction of intussusception.
